narrative.intro: Honeywell Federal Manufacturing and Technologies is the named vendor on federal contracts totaling $2.2B in FY2026 to date. Honeywell Federal Manufacturing and Technologies received 1 award in the current fiscal year, with an average award size of $2.2B. Honeywell Federal Manufacturing and Technologies obligations are up 4.2% year over year. Honeywell Federal Manufacturing and Technologies obligations have moved from $1.7B in FY21 to $2B in FY22, then to $1.8B in FY23 and $1.8B in FY24, and finally to $2.1B in FY25 and $2.2B in FY26. Honeywell Federal Manufacturing and Technologies current-year totals are partial because FY2026 is fiscal year to date. Honeywell Federal Manufacturing and Technologies figures reported here are contract obligations except where tables note award-value or total contract values. Honeywell Federal Manufacturing and Technologies shows a single large award in the current year that dominates the reported obligations and lifts the average award size.

sections.heading: How has Honeywell Federal Manufacturing and Technologies' federal business trended over recent years?
sections.body: Honeywell Federal Manufacturing and Technologies obligations rose from $1.7B in FY21 to $2B in FY22, then fell to $1.8B in FY23 and remained at $1.8B in FY24. Honeywell Federal Manufacturing and Technologies obligations then increased to $2.1B in FY25 and to $2.2B in FY26. Honeywell Federal Manufacturing and Technologies obligations are up 4.2% year over year.
